name: arrange-objects
title: Arrange objects together
signature: arrange(objects: object_list, support: support_ref, max_dist_m: positive_number)
description: Place the listed objects on one support so that they are pairwise within a distance (a place setting).
use_when: Several objects must be grouped together on one support (a setting).

not_to_be_confused_with.sweep: arrange picks and places; sweep pushes.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: grouped
postconditions.meaning: Every listed object is on the support and pairwise within the distance.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: grouped
checks.meaning: Every listed object is on the support and pairwise within the distance.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

chain: for each item in $objects: [navigate](destination=$item) -> [pick](object=$item) -> [navigate](destination=$support) -> [place](object=$item, receptacle=$support, hint_xy=@support.roomiest_xy)

previous.when: a new layout is set on the cleared surface

fallback.reason: frees room for the place setting

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
